info.name: AngleApp
info.description:
Full API surface for angle-app — analysis, instruments, paper trading (replay + live NSE + live MCX), and auth.

Usage: import both this collection AND the AngleApp Local environment; then top-right dropdown → select the environment.

Auth: collection root uses HTTP Basic (alex/demo123). Auth/Home/Dashboard folders override to no-auth. Admin folder uses admin credentials. If you run with spring.profiles.active=nosec, set collection Auth to No Auth.

item.name: Bias Dashboard
item.description:
Live daily-bias sheet — one URL per instrument.

HTML page: /bias or /bias/{token}
JSON API: /api/bias/sheet, /api/bias/sheet/{token}, /api/bias/all

Default instrument comes from bias.instruments[0] in properties. Ad-hoc tokens (not in config) work via /bias/{token} and pick up correct exchange from scrip master.

request.description: Open in browser — HTML page auto-refreshes every 15 min.
Requires {{crudeToken}} to be populated. Look up front-month via /api/instruments/futures?underlying=CRUDEOIL
Returns bias sheet for every configured instrument in one call.

item.name: Bias Dashboard — Section Extracts
item.description:
Same as the JSON sheet, but pre-tested against a specific section for quick review.

All requests use jq-style paths — Postman doesn't apply them automatically, but the URL returns the full sheet and Postman's response filter (top-right of the response body panel) lets you drill into $.marketContext, $.vix, etc.

request.description: Response body → filter: $.marketContext
Response body → filter: $.vix
Response body → filter: $.breadth
Response body → filter: $.multiTfBias
Response body → filter: $.trendFilters
Response body → filter: $.structure
Response body → filter: $.zones
Response body → filter: $.correlated

Response body → filter: $.consolidated

Key fields:
- recommendation: LONG-ONLY / SHORT-ONLY / NO-TRADE
- totalScore: sum across all dimensions
- strength: STRONG / MODERATE / WEAK / NONE
- confidencePercent: 0-100

item.name: Paper Trading — Live MCX
item.description:
Live paper trading on MCX commodities. MCX trades 9:00 AM–11:30 PM IST — different from NSE.

Step 1: use Instruments → Futures — CRUDEOIL to find the current front-month token.
Step 2: paste that token into env var {{crudeToken}}.
Step 3: run the appropriate request below.

item.name: Cache — stats (hits / misses / hit rate / size / heap)

exec: console.log(`Cache:    ${j.size} entries, ${j.hits} hits / ${j.misses} misses (${j.hitRate}% hit rate)`);

request.description: Current CandleCache metrics + JVM heap snapshot. Shows which provider is active (CaffeineCandleCache / NoopCandleCache), cache hit rate, and heap use — watch heap.usedPercent stay below 80%.
Lists every currently-cached entry: broker, exchange, symbol token, interval, date range, and candle count. Small response — safe to poll.
Wipe every cached candle list. Next request per key hits Angel and re-populates the cache. Response reports how many entries were dropped.

Drop every cached entry for the given symbol token (across all intervals + date ranges). Use to force fresh Angel data for one instrument without wiping the whole cache. Change ?token= to any Angel token (e.g. {{bankNiftyToken}}, {{relianceToken}}).

Fires the background warmer immediately — pre-fetches all instruments in bias.instruments[]. Blocks until the round finishes (up to bias.warmer.timeout-seconds). Handy after a POST /clear so the cache is hot before real users hit it.

item.name: Warmer — force warm now (bypass circuit breaker)

request.description: Same as /warm but with ?force=true — bypasses an OPEN circuit breaker so you can test if Angel has recovered.

Re-reads application.properties + rebuilds all @RefreshScope beans (BiasProperties, CandleCacheProperties, TradingProperties, CalendarProperties). No JVM restart. Response lists which property keys changed. Edit the properties file, save, then hit this.
Force circuit breaker back to CLOSED regardless of state. Use when you know Angel is healthy but cooldown hasn't elapsed.

exec: console.log(`Rounds:   ${j.successfulRounds}/${j.totalRounds} ok, ${j.failedRounds} failed, ${j.consecutiveFailures} in a row`);

request.description: Warmer health snapshot: total/successful/failed rounds, timing stats (last/avg/min/max), consecutive failures, last 10 rounds. Console prints a summary; tests warn if failures piling up.

item.description: MySQL-backed instrument management. All requests require ROLE_ADMIN (basic auth). Web UI at /admin/instruments.

request.description: Full HTML admin page — table + add/edit modal + autocomplete.
All instruments (enabled and disabled) with priority + timestamps.
Add a new instrument. symbolToken must be unique (409 if exists).
Update an instrument by its DB id (path). Only fields present in body are changed.
Flip an instrument on/off without deleting it. Warmer + dashboard skip disabled ones on next iteration.
Remove permanently. Cached data in candle_history stays until retention purge.
Search scrip master by symbol/name substring or exact token. Used by the Add modal in the UI.

query.description: symbol or name substring, or exact token

item.name: Live Stream (SSE + Charts)
item.description: Real-time tick + candle push via Angel WebSocket → Server-Sent Events. SSE endpoint requires basic auth; browser pages use session cookie.

request.description:
Long-lived SSE connection. Emits 'tick' + 'candle' events for every enabled instrument. Ctrl+C in curl to disconnect.

Best tested with: curl -N -u admin:admin123 http://localhost:9010/api/live/stream
Same SSE endpoint but filters to only the tokens passed. Can pass ?token=X&token=Y for multiple.
Returns last N candles in TradingView format ({ time, open, high, low, close, volume }). Used by the chart page on load.

All-in-one payload for the chart page. Returns: candles + every indicator series (ema9/20/50, vwap, superTrend, rsi14, macd/signal/histogram) + BUY/SELL markers for the chosen strategy.

Change ?strategy= to any of: ensemble, moving-average-crossover, rsi-mean-reversion, macd-crossover, ob-retest, sweep-fvg, volume-breakout, bollinger-bounce.

query.description: ensemble | moving-average-crossover | rsi-mean-reversion | macd-crossover | ob-retest | sweep-fvg | volume-breakout | bollinger-bounce

item.name: Candles + Indicators + Signals — Volume Breakout on Bank Nifty

request.description: Same endpoint, different instrument + strategy. Handy for comparing signals per strategy.
Live-updating grid of instrument cards. Cards flash green/red on tick. Opens the SSE stream in-browser.
TradingView Lightweight Charts. Loads 300 candles + subscribes to SSE for live updates.

item.name: AI Signal Suggestions (Claude)
item.description: On-demand LLM analysis of the current bias sheet. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var + ai.enabled=true. Responses are cached 5 min per (token, sheet-timestamp) so repeat calls are free.

request.description: Builds Nifty 50 BiasSheet + asks Claude for a 3-sentence trade recommendation. Response includes: action (LONG/SHORT/WAIT/AVOID), confidence, rationale, keyPoints, cached flag.

item.name: Signal Feed (lifecycle)
item.description: Persistent BUY/SELL signals with target/stop tracking. Every consensus signal from SignalDetector is saved to bias_signal table with status=OPEN, then LiveSignalMonitor closes it when target/stop hits. If signals.detector.ai-confirm=true, Claude is also called and a second row with source=AI is saved. Both are shown side-by-side on /signals.

request.description: Full HTML page with stats header, filters, and cards for every signal. Auto-refreshes every signals.feed.auto-refresh-seconds. Open in browser.

exec: const by = (k, v) => arr.filter(s => s[k] === v).length;

request.description: JSON feed. Newest first. Fields per signal: id, createdAt, symbol, symbolToken, exchange, intervalType, action (BUY/SELL), entry, stop, target, agreedStrategies, agreedCount, status (OPEN/HIT_TARGET/HIT_STOP/EXPIRED/CANCELLED), closedAt, closedPrice, profitPoints, profitPercent, source (CONSENSUS/AI), aiConfidence, aiRationale.
Signals still waiting for target/stop. Monitor these — they're your active trades.
Only technical strategy consensus signals (source=CONSENSUS). Excludes AI opinions.
Only Claude AI signals (source=AI). Each has aiConfidence (high/medium/low) and aiRationale (2-4 sentence explanation).
All signals for a specific token. Use to focus on one instrument.
Trade wins in the last week. Use to measure strategy performance.
Trade losses in the last week. Compare to winners for win-rate analysis.

item.name: Feed — AI vs Consensus win-rate compare

request.description: Pulls last 7 days and computes win-rate for CONSENSUS vs AI in Postman test-script console. Great for A/B evaluation.

item.name: Feed — OPEN AI signals for Nifty (focused watch)

request.description: Combined filter — only OPEN + only AI + only Nifty 50 + last 4 hours. Tight watch list.

item.name: Regime Detector (signal gates)
item.description: Config-toggleable market-condition gates that filter signals BEFORE they save. Three independent gates: ADX regime (trend/range/mixed), India VIX ceiling, time-of-day windows. Any disabled gate always passes. Master switch: regime.enabled=false bypasses everything.

request.description: Returns current state: which gates are on, ADX allowed regimes, current India VIX vs ceiling, current IST time vs allowed windows.
Dry-run: tells you whether a Nifty signal RIGHT NOW would be allowed to fire. No signal is saved; safe to poll.
Re-parses allowed-regimes and allowed-windows CSVs. Also flushes the regime cache. Use this after editing application.properties and hot-reloading them (or use /admin/config-reload).

item.name: Flip master switch OFF (bypass all gates)

request.description: Runtime toggle. Once off, EVERY signal fires (as before regime was added). Useful to sanity-check that regime is what's filtering signals.
Disable just the ADX regime gate while keeping VIX + time filters active.
Disable the time filter to allow signals at ANY hour (useful for testing outside market hours).

item.name: Trailing Stops (ratchet)
item.description: Config-toggleable trailing-stop engine. Runs on every tick; tightens each OPEN signal's stop when price moves favorably. Never loosens. Modes: NONE / FIXED / PERCENT / MILESTONE / ATR.

request.description: Reverts to classic fixed-stop behavior. All OPEN signals keep their current stop (last-known trailed value stays).
Discrete profit-locking. Default ladder locks breakeven at 50%, 33% at 75%, 66% at 90% of the move.
Best for gappy or high-vol instruments. Trail = K × ATR14 behind peak.

item.name: Tune — tighter PERCENT (0.25% trail, activate at 20%)

request.description: Aggressive: engages sooner (20% into move) and trails closer (0.25%). More trades stopped early, but locks in profit faster.

item.name: Tune — looser PERCENT (0.6% trail, activate at 50%)

request.description: Conservative: waits until halfway, gives price more room. Fewer stop-outs, less profit locked.
Set your own ladder. Format: CSV of 'moveAt%:stopAt%'. Example below: at 40%→BE, at 70%→50% locked, at 90%→80% locked.

item.name: Multi-Timeframe Confirmation
item.description: After consensus + dedupe fire but BEFORE save: verify higher timeframes agree in direction. Signal on 5M BUY only saves if 15M + 1H both agree UP. Modes ALL/MAJORITY/ANY. Methods EMA_STACK / PRICE_VS_EMA / SUPERTREND. Master switch: mtf.enabled=false bypasses.

item.name: Dry-run — would Nifty 5m BUY be confirmed?

request.description: Reports whether a hypothetical BUY signal on Nifty 5m would pass MTF right now. Shows each higher-TF direction so you can see why.

item.name: Dry-run — would Nifty 5m SELL be confirmed?

request.description: Widen to 3 higher timeframes. With mode=ALL this becomes strictest — 3-of-3 must agree.

item.name: News Blackout Calendar
item.description: Skip signals within window around scheduled events (RBI, FOMC, earnings, expiry). YAML calendar at src/main/resources/news-calendar.yml. Edit → POST /api/news/reload (or auto-reloads every 5 min). Master: news.enabled. Severity threshold: news.block-severity.

request.description: Open in browser: active/upcoming/all events, reload button, enable/disable toggles.

exec: if (arr.length === 0) { console.log('✅ No active blackouts — signals free to fire.'); }

request.description: Reliance-only earnings events in the sample YAML block only Reliance token, not Nifty.
Edit src/main/resources/news-calendar.yml (or your absolute-path file), then POST here. No restart needed.

item.name: Master switch OFF (allow signals during news)
